'''Lee-Chee Mukmuk''' was a yellow [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]] who was seen in [[Slum district G17/Legends|Slum district G17]] alongside two [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] criminals during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The Kowakian saw the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] when the young [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and her Master, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were looking for the Weequay criminal [[Car Affa/Legends|Car Affa]].

==Behind the scenes==
Lee-Chee Mukmuk, credited as "'''Muk Muk Monkey'''", was voiced by [[Jaime King]], who also voiced [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]] in "[[Lightsaber Lost]]," an episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. King additionally voiced [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] in the series.
